sloka: वाचयामास रामस्य वने स्वस्त्ययनक्रियाः ।ततस्तन्मै द्विजेन्द्राय राममाता यशस्विनी ॥२-२५-३१॥
transliteration: vācayāmāsa rāmasya vane svastyayanakriyāḥ ।tatastanmai dvijendrāya rāmamātā yaśasvinī ॥2-25-31॥

translations.english: The illustrious Kausalya, mother of Rama gave abundant gifts to the best of the brahmins and thereafter said to him:
